integrity: The proof includes exact generator rates, stationary moment equations, and a stationary diffusion-limit argument. A standalone stdlib rational-arithmetic checker independently enumerates 16 finite stationary distributions and validates 361 moment systems; finite tests are not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time uniform-neighbor voter copying on K_{a,b} with exactly two fixed opposite zealots. Exact pair formulas for finite a,b>=2; same-side pairs only if that part has at least two flexible vertices. Beta weak limit only under simultaneous proportional growth a/(a+b)->rho in (0,1), at stationarity. No claim of transient convergence rates or general graph topologies. No independent external verification.
title: An exact correlation law and a beta limit for competing zealots on complete bipartite voter networks
